tools.name: sr_get_articles
tools.description: List Streaming Radar newsletter articles with optional filters. Returns title, subtitle, status, type, views, open_rate, editorial_angle, and clickable links. Free access — no API key required.

tools.name: sr_get_article
tools.description: Get a single Streaming Radar article by ID or edition number, including full content, linked experts, and editorial angle. Free access — no API key required.

tools.name: sr_search_articles
tools.description:
Full-text search across Streaming Radar articles, or — with mode=coverage — check whether a topic is already covered in the published corpus using semantic similarity (SR_CORPUS Vectorize index).

mode=search (default): full-text search on title, subtitle, editorial_angle. Free access, no API key re

tools.name: sr_get_experts
tools.description: List experts cited in the Streaming Radar newsletter with optional filters by tier or country. Free access — no API key required.

tools.name: sr_get_tags
tools.description: List tags used in the Streaming Radar newsletter, optionally filtered by category. Free access — no API key required.

tools.name: sr_get_new_since
tools.description: Get articles published since a given date, ordered by publication date descending. Free access — no API key required.

tools.name: sr_get_expert
tools.description: Get a single expert by ID or name (partial match), including their linked articles. Free access — no API key required.

tools.name: story_list_genres
tools.description: List all available genre tiers (Proven / Growing / Emerging) and hybrid combinations for the vertical drama story bible generator.

tools.name: story_list_markets
tools.description: List all target markets with audience profiles and top genres for the vertical drama story bible generator.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the full MCP catalog for tools not in the core set. Returns matching tools with their full schemas, ready to call via tools/call.
